article.title: The long-range drone war: Ukraine and Russia scramble for supremacy in the skies
article.summary: A conflict that began with tanks and then artillery is now pivoting around a new generation of drones focused on military, industrial, economic and civilian targetsFinally, in the dead of night, the threat above has passed. The rain has eased and the Ukrainian drones are ready, prepared by a ground crew shrouded in hard-to-detect green and red lights. A small succession of Ukrainian Fire Point FP-2 craft, miniature monoplanes with a 6-metre wingspan and more than 100kg of explosive, line up for an attack mission into occupied Luhansk, over 200 miles away.The drone’s main piston engine is a familiar scooter’s buzz, but its launch booster is something else. The jet sound reverberates, almost painfully. A burst of fire lurches into the distance, the last of which signifies it is time for Ukraine’s 413 Raid drone regiment to pack and go.The launch of an FP-2 drone during the mission into occupied LuhanskContinue reading...

article.title: ‘They Were Sorting Vegetables’: Russian Attack Kills 6 Workers in Kharkiv Oblast

article.summary: The second part of this investigation examines the global reach of Russia’s foreign recruitment campaign, focusing on South Asia, Latin America, Indonesia, and former Soviet states.
